rows: Information About Local Disk Space & Azure Storage

<markdown>
- By default, your Azure App Service content in /home is stored on Azure Storage and is surfaced up in a durable manner as a content share. There is latency involved in accessing content on Azure Storage and so high frequency of read/write operations should be performed outside of /home.

- Your content stored outside of /home is stored on the local disk (at the host's /mnt) of the host VM assigned to the App Service Plan. This space is separate from the operating system storage (at /), is highly performant, and is not expandable without scaling up.

- Your container images, in most cases, are all stored on the same local disk at /mnt. In some cases when the host has a smaller local disk, some of those images will be stored on the operating system disk (at /). As a result, when writing outside of /home, since those changes are written to where the images are stored, they may be written to either /mnt or /.

- Please consider the following if experiencing high disk space usage or no space left on device:
   - Reduce the size of your container image.
   - Avoid accumulating large amounts of logs and files. 
   - Isolate the largest container image and split your App Service plan if using multiple custom containers.
       </markdown>
